title: Chair, vice-chair, and secretary-treasurer.
bodyText: The trustees shall elect from among the members a chair, a vice-chair, and a secretary-treasurer.
bodyHtml: [§87A-7]  Chair, vice-chair, and secretary-treasurer.  The trustees shall elect from among the members a chair, a vice-chair, and a secretary-treasurer. [L 2001, c 88, pt of §1]
